implementation_notes: Did NOT touch R021 (B8 territory) or notebook code (B7 territory).
Did NOT bump versions or change Diagnostic schema.
Did NOT touch paper/, references/, or scripts/ directories.

Both helpers operate on the module-level AST passed via BaseRule.check(tree); no source-text reading was needed because the FP examples in PR-029 use either function-name patterns (link_patient_id_to_outcome) or triple-quoted docstrings ('Splitting is done by patient id ... Reduce every patient to a single outcome'), both of which survive in the AST as Call/Constant nodes.

_data_is_deduplicated_per_group operates on the function/module scope rather than tracking flow precisely; this is conservative and acceptable per the user's spec ('simple AST walk inside the function/scope is fine').

For R008, mere presence of a temporal keyword (e.g. 'admission' inside 'case_admission_id') is no longer sufficient. The new gate requires DatetimeIndex assignment, pd.to_datetime call, sequence-style kwargs/vars, 3D LSTM input, or a recurrent-layer instantiation.
